instructions: Human source subjects first, all predictions second. AI cannot supply human reviewer identity or judgments.
Set expected_groups to central-subject strings, or [] when none; leave undecidable source subjects pending with an explanation.
Every assigned label from both extractors needs useful true/false, reason, and covers_expected_groups indexes. Useful secondary labels can cover none.
Record omissions and useful phrase variants separately; do not alter frozen model gold or delete an inconvenient label.

Score each corpus separately: macro precision over human-substantive notes, macro recall of central groups; include every label and independently report false topics on empty/stub notes. Compare baseline at limit5.
Apply unchanged .50 precision/.60 recall and zero false topics on empty cases. Excluded controls remain boundary evidence, not a relevance denominator.
The extra diary case belongs to this human review even though it has no existing model score. Never silently drop it from human results.
A complete score does not alone establish corpus representativeness. Do not claim a fresh holdout or general real-owner usefulness.
Null and incomplete reviews are pending, never approval. No review or merge approval is supplied by this packet.
